items.name: Nandini Sankara
items.quote: Blowhorn gave us one place to run every brand voice we manage. The queue keeps our regional teams aligned without bottlenecking everything through corporate.

items.name: Doug Martin
items.quote: We publish across a dozen profiles, and Blowhorn is the first tool that treats that as the normal case instead of the edge case. Write once, review once, ship everywhere.

items.name: Jason Fish
items.quote: Speed matters in our world. I can draft a post in the morning and have it live across every store-region profile before lunch, with a dry run first, so nothing goes out half-baked.

items.name: Elisa Ng
items.quote: Field marketing lives and dies on getting event content out fast. Blowhorn lets me queue a week's worth of regional posts in one sitting.

items.name: Lovely Villamor
items.quote: My old outreach tool wanted my LinkedIn password. With Blowhorn my logins stay in my own Chrome on my own computer.

items.name: Dylan Wiley
items.quote: DevRel is half announcements. I write the update once and Blowhorn puts it everywhere our developers actually are: same message, every channel, no copy-paste drift.

items.name: Andy Modrovich
items.quote: The --dry-run flag sold me. I can rehearse an entire multi-profile announcement, see exactly what goes where, and only then hit publish.

items.name: David Skuza
items.quote: Small team, big surface area. Blowhorn lets one DevRel engineer run a publishing operation that used to take a whole comms team.

items.name: Sangmin Lee
items.quote: Our community lives on five different platforms. Blowhorn means patch notes and event announcements go out everywhere simultaneously, in one motion.

items.name: Violett Cruz
items.quote: I run our whole social calendar from Blowhorn's queue and honestly forget the individual platforms exist. It just publishes.
